tldr: Black Moon Lilith transiting the 7th house: the disowned self activates through partnership.
body: Black Moon Lilith moving through the 7th house can activate the disowned self through partners, clients, agreements, and one-to-one dynamics. For roughly nine months, relationship mirrors may expose control patterns, autonomy wounds, and the places where equal footing has been compromised.
business: The disowned self activates through partners, and control dynamics become harder to ignore.
shadow: Power struggles, disappearing inside the bond, or making the relationship carry a reclamation that has to begin inside the self.
advice: Reclaim equal footing without assuming the bond has to end for your autonomy to exist.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
